name: model-scale
description: Routes work to the cheapest Claude model and effort that should do it well: scores each prompt on a six-level scale (haiku to fable), sets the thinking effort per turn, optionally picks the model for a new conversation, gives general-purpose subagents the model their task means, and shows an estimated saving with /scale.

agentTypes.title: Subagent types to route
agentTypes.description: Comma-separated agent types whose spawns get a model from their task (when the Agent call names none). Other types keep the model they have. Default: general-purpose.
